_comment: README 카드의 원본. public 은 스타 수를 실제로 조회하고, private 는 적힌 그대로 그린다. private desc 는 [무엇, 핵심 기능] 두 줄. 순서가 곧 화면 순서(2열). plugins 는 공개 플러그인 — 2열 카드에 스타 수와 설치 명령 두 줄.

public.title: tgx-agent-mesh
public.desc: A general-purpose agent plugin, not tied to any one tool.

plugins.title: tgx-docent
desc: Turns web app source into screen lists and user manuals.
Every claim cites file:line; captures and GIFs, out to HTML · PDF · PPT.

plugins.title: test-guard
desc: Stops agents from deleting or skipping tests to make them pass.
Agent hook · commit-msg hook · GitHub Action — no LLM.

private.title: TG Platform
desc: The backend standard every TG repo follows.
RFC 9457 error contract · traceId logs in a single starter.

private.title: TGX Agent Chatbot
desc: A general chatbot that drops into any site as a widget.
Agentic RAG on a local LLM, multi-tenant with guardrails.

private.title: TG-Nova
desc: A fintech backend — transfer, pay and invest on one ledger.
Balances are never stored — always derived from the ledger.

private.title: Sijang Market
desc: A B2B market linking wholesalers and restaurant owners.
Brand · HQ · store three-tier multi-tenancy + Outbox async.

private.title: NeoMusiq
desc: Booking app for a contemporary music academy.
Practice rooms and lessons booked in one install-free PWA.

private.title: TG Launcher
desc: The single door into every deployed TG site.
Google account + TOTP two-step auth, then SSO.
